summary: FS Credit Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Tenth Amendment to its Master Repurchase Agreement with Barclays Bank PLC. The amendment extends the availability period from February 21, 2028 to February 21, 2029. This is a routine financing agreement modification with no change to terms like price per share, premium, or special-situation mechanics. There is no activist involvement, strategic review, or change of control. The event is a standard contractual extension for an existing credit facility, not a special situation. No deal terms are provided as the filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, or similar event.
